    cmap_data += struct.pack('>H', 1)  # encodingID (Unicode BMP)
    cmap_data += struct.pack('>I', 12)  # offset to subtable

    fmt4_data += struct.pack('>H', 24)  # length

    chain += struct.pack('>I', 0)  # chainLength placeholder
    chain += struct.pack('>I', n_feature_entries)
    chain += struct.pack('>I', 1)  # nSubtables = 1
    chain += chain_features
    chain += cst

    range_shift = num_tables * 16 - search_range

    offset_table += struct.pack('>H', search_range)
    offset_table += struct.pack('>H', entry_selector)
    offset_table += struct.pack('>H', range_shift)

    current_offset = dir_size
